name: universe-generator
description: Seeded galaxies, star systems, planets and moons: the same universe as the C# and Unity UniverseGenerator for the same seed. Zero dependencies, TypeScript, ESM and CommonJS, Node 20+.
author: Mark Rogers

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:dist
scripts.test:dist: node --test test/golden/manifest.test.js test/golden/core.test.js test/golden/star-name.test.js test/golden/shapes.test.js test/golden/system.test.js test/golden/galaxy.test.js test/golden/names.test.js test/golden/tables.test.js test/golden/planet.test.js test/golden/moon-belt.test.js test/golden/orbital-elements.test.js test/golden/galaxy-extras.test.js test/golden/constraints.test.js test/golden/diagnostics.test.js test/golden/presets.test.js test/golden/cluster.test.js test/golden/universe.test.js test/golden/export.test.js test/golden/hooks.test.js test/unit/*.test.js test/package/shape.test.js
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --check-coverage --lines 95 --branches 90 --exclude-after-remap --include "src/**" --reporter text --reporter lcov node --test test/golden/core.test.js test/golden/star-name.test.js test/golden/shapes.test.js test/golden/system.test.js test/golden/galaxy.test.js test/golden/names.test.js test/golden/tables.test.js test/golden/planet.test.js test/golden/moon-belt.test.js test/golden/orbital-elements.test.js test/golden/galaxy-extras.test.js test/golden/constraints.test.js test/golden/diagnostics.test.js test/golden/presets.test.js test/golden/cluster.test.js test/golden/universe.test.js test/golden/export.test.js test/golden/hooks.test.js test/unit/*.test.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm test
